court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Bombay Forgings Ltd vs Manilal And Son
facts_of_case: The suit property is owned by the Defendant. The Plaintiff claims that under a Deed of Lease executed in 1972, they were entitled to extend the lease for another 30 years. The trial court rejected the Plaint.

legal_principles.principle: A renewal of a lease involves the execution of an altogether fresh lease deed.
legal_principles.held: He urged that this principle laid down in binding precedent has not been considered by the learned Single Judge in the case of ING Vysya Bank Ltd., as the attention of the learned Single Judge was not invited to the said decision and to the fact that renewal may involve execution of an altogether fresh lease deed.
cited_cases: ING Vysya Bank Ltd. Vs. Modern India Ltd.
Delhi Development Authority Vs. Durga Chand Kaushish
Provash Chandra Dalui Vs. Biswanath Banerjee

legal_principles.principle: A distinction exists between extension and renewal of a lease, with renewal involving the execution of a new lease.
legal_principles.held: He invited our attention to the material averments made in the plaint and in particular to the prayer clauses. He pointed out that there is a specific prayer for enforcing specific performance of the obligations of the defendant under the said Indenture of lease by renewing the said Lease.
cited_cases: Delhi Development Authority Vs. Durga Chand Kaushish
Provash Chandra Dalui Vs. Biswanath Banerjee
